Tiring day cheers for the shift leads
A month with leash checks in mind
Leash Checks, Calm Hands, Smooth Flights
The Companion Animal Travel Desk has kept things steady with simple checks, clear notes, and patient handoffs across Aurelia Skyways. Travelers and pets move easier when the desk stays sharp on paperwork, carrier fit, and calm updates at the counter. When a concern does come up, the team follows a calm stepwise review and keeps the tone friendly from start to finish. Small fixes, clear guidance, and steady teamwork have made the routine feel lighter for everyone involved.
